title: WebCitation
description: Citation for a web-derived claim (ADR 0047). Assembled by the core after fetch. Every web number in the answer must appear in the fetched text of its citation.

id.description: Core-minted citation id (prefix wcit_). Matches common typedId: lowercase prefix plus uppercase Crockford ULID. The older lowercase body form remains valid (additive).

title.description: Page title as retrieved (sanitised plain text).

snippet.description: Optional short excerpt used for verification display.

content_hash.description: Optional SHA-256 of the extracted page text (sha256: + 64 lower-case hex digits).
